name: Foundry
description: The product engineering arm. Every web platform, mobile application, and hardware system CloudAlls ships is forged here — from rapid prototyping through production-grade delivery, backed by cloud infrastructure that keeps everything running.

name: Intelligence
description: The applied intelligence arm. AI systems, research-backed innovation, and workflow automation are deployed here as measurable operational assets that remove manual work and sharpen decisions.

name: Growth
description: The growth arm. Performance marketing, search visibility, and strategic brand consulting turn attention into measurable business results — every campaign traced from first click to signed invoice.

name: Studio
description: The creative arm. Visual identity systems, premium print, cinematic video, and product photography — brand work that performs equally on screen and in hand.

name: Operations & Security
description: The operations arm. Zero-trust physical security, biometric access, and end-to-end event and corporate operations management — keeping facilities safe and business moving without friction.

name: Academy
description: The education arm. Professional masterclasses, corporate upskilling, and structured internships with direct hiring pathways — top-performing interns are frequently offered full-time roles.
